title: Cobble Champs Official
description: This is the official modpack for Cobble Champs!
body:
# Cobble Champs

Cobble Champs is a community-driven Cobblemon survival experience built around adventure, progression, and player choice.

Choose from unique profile paths like Ironman, Nuzlocke, Monotype, or Islander, each offering a completely different way to experience the world. Battle your way through the ranks, level up professions, earn exclusive titles, claim territories, complete world first achievements, and build your legacy alongside other trainers.

Our goal is simple: create a Pokémon-inspired multiplayer world that captures the excitement of exploration and discovery while adding long-term progression systems designed for an MMO-style experience.

## Features

• Cobblemon survival with custom progression systems
• Player territories and guilds
• Professions and skill leveling
• Unique profile modes including Ironman, Nuzlocke, Monotype, and Islander
• Custom TM system with multiple acquisition methods
• World First achievements and unlockable titles
• Trainer NPCs, world bosses, and special encounters
• Economy designed around meaningful progression
• Frequent updates shaped by community feedback

Whether you want to become a legendary battler, master every profession, conquer challenging profile restrictions, or simply explore the world with friends, there's a place for you in Cobble Champs.

The journey to become Champion starts here.

Join our Discord to stay updated on announcements, beta information, and future content releases.
